newsitem.title: UK: Deutsche Bank to cut home shareholdings - FT.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank to cut home shareholdings - FT.

text.p: LONDON, May 20 (Reuter) Deutsche Bank is planning to reduce its industrial holdings in some of Germany's largest companies and build stakes in foreign concerns, its new chairman said in the Financial Times.
"We are a European bank, we want to be the number one bank in Europe and in the euro and we basically have a portfolio of only German holdings," he was quoted by the paper as saying.
"I have always said we want to Europeanise if not internationalise our portfolio," he added.
He would not say what foreign holdings the bank might acquire but he said it would take a global view.
This would include Europe, North America and the Asia-Pacific region.
Breuer said there could eventually be a 50-50 balance between holdings in German and foreign companies.
